svg.title: Case 74: prompt-policy evidence and the current JCI query
svg.desc: Exploratory real-task evidence. A simplified semantic sketch identifies an HTML safety requirement. In the Raw-prepared policy, all four retained-requirement requests pass finite safety checks and all four removed-requirement requests show unsafe DOM features. The current ten-task structural panel uses C for P/N assignment and X for the preassigned REMOVE family. JCI adds only a context-to-outcome orientation in three of thirty-two resamples; no X-Y safety edge is found.
svg.text: Case 74: prompt-policy evidence and the current JCI query
Exploratory real-task evidence | HTML generation | Limited safety and functionality checks

svg.text: No additional X–Y safety relation was identified.
The policy comparison supports a task-specific behavioral contrast; a transferable semantic cause remains unestablished.
Four requests share one task. Resampling the same task panel does not increase its independent sample size.
Evidence: tsg-preparation-repair and causal-comparison-results, 2026-09-29. Semantic lines, workflow arrows and PAG edges have distinct meanings.
